extracted.name: Apple Orchard Punch
extracted.description: This apple orchard punch recipe is alcohol-free and combines apple, cranberry, and orange juices with ginger ale for a perfect drink for any occasion.
ingredient_lines: 1 (32 fluid ounce) bottle apple juice, chilled
1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen cranberry juice concentrate
instruction_lines: Combine apple juice, cranberry juice concentrate, and orange juice. Stir until dissolved; slowly add ginger ale.
Thinly slice apple horizontally. Float slices on top of punch.
